glitch_checks.symptom: Player stops dead on a rock slope slightly over 45 degrees
glitch_checks.likely_cause: Default floor angle is 45 degrees and the generated rock is rough
glitch_checks.mitigation: Raise max_floor_angle to 60 degrees and keep floor_stop_on_slope off
glitch_checks.test: Walk straight up the island slope at walk and sprint speed with tools/debug_walk.gd; progress must not stall.

glitch_checks.symptom: Snagging or stalling on small lips and plank edges
glitch_checks.likely_cause: Trimesh edges higher than the capsule skin
glitch_checks.mitigation: Step-up: if blocked, test a raised capsule and lift by step_height
glitch_checks.test: Walk along the gangway and across plank joints; no stall and no visible hop.

glitch_checks.symptom: Camera lags or snaps when turning while moving
glitch_checks.likely_cause: Smoothed mouse look or rotating the wrong node
glitch_checks.mitigation: Rotate the body on yaw and the Head on pitch directly from raw mouse motion, no smoothing
glitch_checks.test: Walk forward while sweeping the mouse; turning must track the mouse 1:1 and the path must curve smoothly.

glitch_checks.symptom: Player wedged in a corner or between two walls
glitch_checks.mitigation: Allow six slides and a small safe_margin; add a nudge-out if velocity stays zero while input is held for 1 s
glitch_checks.test: Drive into the tunnel corner and the barrier corners holding two keys; the player must slide out.

glitch_checks.symptom: Player falls through the island or sea collider
glitch_checks.likely_cause: Trimesh holes or a collider not loaded yet
glitch_checks.mitigation: Wait one physics frame after colliders are built before enabling movement; respawn below the fall limit
glitch_checks.test: Run the spawn test 20 times and sprint along every edge of the island; never fall through.

glitch_checks.likely_cause: Movement scaled by frame count instead of delta
glitch_checks.mitigation: Use delta in all velocity changes and keep physics at a fixed rate
glitch_checks.test: Cap the game at 30, 60 and 144 fps and time the walk between two points; results must match.

glitch_checks.symptom: Camera clips into walls or jitters on steps
glitch_checks.likely_cause: Camera parented to a body that moves in steps
glitch_checks.mitigation: Raise the Head smoothly (lerp the step offset) and keep the near clip at 0.05 m
glitch_checks.test: Walk into walls and up the stone steps; the view must not poke through geometry or judder.
